name: Professors and Academics
blurb: Teaching and supervising the next generation.

members.hook: Ng did more than any single figure to turn machine learning from a graduate-school subject into a skill anyone could learn online, while simultaneously building the industrial-scale infrastructure, Google Brain among it, that made deep learning practical at big-tech scale.
members.name: Andrew Ng
members.moniker: AI Educator and Deep Learning Pioneer

members.hook: Bakalar leads AI ethics at OpenAI after nearly four years as Chief Ethicist at Meta, where she moved from Responsible AI research into leading ethics across GenAI Trust and Safety and Meta Superintelligence Labs. She holds a PhD in Political Science from the University of Pennsylvania and spent seven years on the faculty at Temple University before moving into industry.
members.name: Chloé Bakalar

members.hook: Brynjolfsson has spent three decades building the empirical case for how digital technology, and now AI, actually changes productivity and jobs, work that shifted from academic papers to boardroom strategy as generative AI forced every company to ask the same question he had been measuring for years.
members.name: Erik Brynjolfsson
members.moniker: Economist of the Second Machine Age

members.hook: Li made modern AI's breakthrough possible by betting on data before it was fashionable: ImageNet's fourteen million labeled images gave the field the benchmark on which AlexNet proved deep learning worked. She has spent the years since insisting the technology stay pointed at people, building Stanford HAI and carrying the human-centered case into policy rooms from Sacramento to Washington.
members.name: Fei-Fei Li

members.hook: Hinton kept faith with neural networks through two AI winters, and won. The training method he championed in 1986 and the 2012 breakthrough his lab produced turned a marginal idea into the technology behind modern AI. Then, at the peak of vindication, he quit Google to warn the world about what he had helped build, giving AI risk its most credentialed voice.
members.name: Geoffrey Hinton

members.hook: Dixon became Chancellor of North Carolina Central University in 2024 after leading Elizabeth City State University for over eight years, including as interim and then permanent Chancellor, and after six years overseeing academic and student affairs system-wide for the 17-campus University of North Carolina system. Her research has focused on college access and summer bridge programs.
members.name: Karrie G. Dixon

members.hook: Katti built his career on the unglamorous but essential problem of moving data efficiently, first in academic networking research, then running Intel's networking hardware division, and now at OpenAI, where the physical compute infrastructure behind frontier AI models is his direct responsibility.
members.name: Sachin Katti
members.moniker: OpenAI's Head of Compute and Former Stanford Networking Professor

members.hook: Thrun proved autonomous driving was possible by winning DARPA's toughest robotics prize, then built the Google program that turned that proof into Waymo, the industry's leading self-driving company, while separately co-founding Udacity to bring university-grade technical education online.
members.name: Sebastian Thrun
members.moniker: Founder of Google's Self-Driving Car Project and Udacity
